items.title: 67426_Hayes Pillars oral history interview
items.q: There was a gentleman named S. D. Dudley Buttley, a showman and a show producer, who was producing the show.

ctx.x: To get people to vote for our band.//

We finished that summer up and they brought the band in St. Louis to start rehearsing the floor show to open at the Club Plantation. There was a gentleman named S. D. Dudley Buttley, a showman and a show producer, who was producing the show. Back in those days we always had a line of girls, eight girls, chorus girls and comedians, always would bring in a dance team and we'd bring in some outstanding singer for the floor show.
And each floor show would last starting there two weeks, was it two weeks?
